releaseNotes: Made the welcome and onboarding screens more inviting with a larger food photograph, clearer typography and purposeful stage icons across mobile, tablet and web.
Redesigned the weekly meal preview as a readable seven-day calendar, with larger evenly spaced meal selection buttons and clearly marked dinner and lunch days.
Kept the Continue button accessible on small phones while allowing longer onboarding pages to scroll. Improved selection semantics without changing saved preferences or personal data.
Centred the plus icon on My Recipes through the shared button layout, without one-off offsets or additional forced CSS priorities.
Aligned page headings with adjacent controls throughout MyWeek and made Before you shop use the established shopping page heading.
Removed obsolete layout rules and CSS exception records. Added regression checks for seven onboarding layouts, buttons, headings and offline features.
